title: The Ozone Hole Is Healing. When Will It Close?
description:
CFCs from fridges and sprays damaged the ozone layer. The 1987 Montreal Protocol phased them out. The 2026 UNEP/WMO Scientific Assessment expects recovery around 2040 for most of the world and during the 2060s over Antarctica. It no longer gives a specific Arctic return year.

Sources:
• 2026 WMO/UNEP Ozone Assessment Executive Summary: https://ozone.unep.org/sites/default/files/2026-10/OA2026ExecSummary.pdf
• NOAA CSL: Scientific Assessment of Ozone Depletion 2026: https://www.csl.noaa.gov/assessments/ozone/2026/
• UNEP Ozone Secretariat, Montreal Protocol Article 15: https://ozone.unep.org/treaties/montreal-protocol/articles/article-15-signature
